records.title: Confidence-Adaptive SwiGLU for Mixture-of-Experts
records.reason: Confidence-adaptive SwiGLU changes token-dependent MoE expert gate sharpness and improves CORE scores, but the full text reports about 4–7% extra compute from elementwise operations and calls for deployment-metric evaluation. The model-level MoE relation is plausible, while the measured cost overhead and missing serving benefit leave scope relevance unresolved.
